bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 $595–627，仍低于 10 日均线

read.en: Lumentum rose 10.7% on Nov 11 to $648.06, trading $633.59–678.67. It is above the 5-day ($575.6) and below the 10-day ($663.0), 30-day ($847.9), 100-day ($846.1) and 200-day ($811.6); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($816.05), and RSI is 40.6.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月11日上涨 10.7%，收于 $648.06，盘中区间 $633.59–678.67。股价位于 5 日均线（$575.6）上方，10 日（$663.0）、30 日（$847.9）、100 日（$846.1）和 200 日均线（$811.6）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$816.05），RSI 为 40.6。

read.en: The rally reclaimed the $594.8–602.3 Jul 28–29 lows and the $612.6–626.8 zone (Nov 9–10 highs, Nov 4 close), now support; the $678.67 high stalled under the $680–684 Nov 2–3 closes, and the close fell back below the 10-day. Resistance is $651–663 (Nov 4 high, 10-day), then $679–684 and $720. Support is $612.6–633.6, then $594.8–602.3 and $570–576. A close above $663 would target $679–684; below $612.6, $595–602.

r.en: Nov 11 high $678.67; Nov 3 and Nov 2 closes ($680.2–684.4)
